t: LAP 13A 2-Gang Switched Plug Sockets in brushed stainless steel deliver professional-grade performance for any installation. These wall-mounted twin earth sockets feature angled in-line terminals with backed-out captive screws, accepting cable capacities from 2.5mm² to 6mm². The raised rounded profile and white inserts provide a contemporary finish, whilst the screwed faceplate ensures secure, reliable mounting into standard 25mm back boxes. Ideal for commercial and residential applications requiring durable 240V switched power distribution.
